title: Pencils of norm form equations and a conjecture of Thomas, II
summary: We continue our studies on parametric norm forms $F_t({\bf x})$, with ${\bf x}=(x_0,x_1,\ldots,x_{d-1})$ lying in some parametric linear subvariety $W_t$ and integers $t$ sufficiently large. In a previous paper [Am-Ma-Za2] we proved some effective specialization results for integer solutions $\bf x$ of $F_t({\bf x})=1$. Here we modify our techniques to treat $F_t({\bf x})=q$ for an arbitrary integer $q$. Under mild conditions (not however including the crucial index assumption in [Am-Ma-Za2]) we show that all $\bf x$ are polynomially bounded in terms of $|q|$ and $t$. As in [Am-Ma-Za2] we…
